name: seaworthy
description: Ship iOS apps from Claude Code with Xcode Cloud and App Store Connect: see what a push will ship, catch builds that never started or failed, triage failures, check release readiness, and submit for review, with your own API key.

key_id.title: App Store Connect API key ID
key_id.description: Key ID of an App Store Connect API key (Users and Access → Integrations). App Manager role or higher to submit.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Shown above the key list in Users and Access → Integrations.

private_key.title: Private key (.p8 contents)
private_key.description: The AuthKey_<key ID>.p8 file as one line (macOS: tr -d '\n' < AuthKey_<key ID>.p8 | pbcopy), BEGIN and END lines included. Stored in the system keychain, not in settings.json.

push_warning.title: Warn before pushes that start Xcode Cloud
push_warning.description: One line before a git push saying which workflows it starts and where the builds go.

build_watch.title: Watch builds after a push
build_watch.description: After a push that should start Xcode Cloud, tell Claude if no build started within 4 minutes or the build failed.
